conclusion: A separate immutable successor semantic_test_pdf_seal_producer follows semantic_test_pdf_recipe_guard. It aligns check_pdf_build with ops.data_derivation.producer_task_id and changes neither the sealed-run alternative nor ddo_support_valid gate. Original producer provenance remains distinct from an adopting current publication fence; exact request/generation/intent checks stay with their existing owners. Compatible predecessor access survives a changed companion, native identity controls pass, and real clone acquisition crosses the former mixed-collector boundary. The earlier 79-case attempt remains failed with 32 passes and 47 fixture-lookup setup failures; the smaller retry does not qualify those 47 cases or establish broader DDO/adoption/support-validity qualification. The persistent development database remains at semantic_bep_located_v2 with the same OID/system identity: no deployment, adoption, activation, schema rollback or DDO cutover occurred.
